about:
Siri Wire Co. has operated from Danielson, Connecticut since its founding in 1992. The company is a fourth‑generation family business with more than 50 years of industry experience, and it remains led by the family that built it from the ground up.

The company manufactures and stocks stainless steel and alloy wire, serving customers across North America. Its product range includes electro‑polish quality (EPQ) wire — held in one of the largest domestic stocking positions in the region — as well as cold‑heading and spring wire grades such as 302, 304, 316, 17‑7, 302HQ, 303, 316L, 410, 416, 420, and 430. Siri Wire also provides annealing via strand annealing furnaces, coating and redraw services for customer‑supplied material, and straight‑and‑cut processing. Through its affiliation with Tri Star Metals and the Bender Wire Group, the company now operates behind two fully operational American production mills, enabling domestic melt, DFARS‑compliant, and non‑DFARS material options.

Siri Wire serves medical and surgical device manufacturers, aerospace and defense contractors, automotive suppliers, fastener and cold‑heading producers, filter screen and washer makers, and general industrial customers. Common applications include springs, fasteners, medical equipment, filter screens, washers, and rings.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001 certification, American‑made production, and a team that stands behind every order. Differentiators cited by the company include same‑day and short lead‑time shipping on stocked EPQ wire, the backing of two domestic mills for broader product range and engineering support, and a family‑owned culture focused on integrity and competitive pricing.
